heroText: Japan System supports your company's DX (Digital Transformation) with world-class IT solutions, system integration, and online marketing tailored for the Japanese and Thai business ecosystem.
newsDesc1: Stay updated with our latest product launches, software releases, and corporate announcements — including e-Tax Invoice and MYLOGSTAR.

missionDesc: To empower businesses in Thailand and across Southeast Asia with cutting-edge IT solutions and digital transformation services grounded in Japanese precision and expertise.
visionDesc: To become the most trusted Japanese IT partner for companies operating in the Thai and ASEAN market, bridging the technology gap between Japan and Southeast Asia.
spotlightDesc: MYLOGSTAR is a powerful PC operation log collection and management solution — no dedicated management server required. Monitor file access, user activity, and device operations for complete security and compliance.
mylogstarLogPowerDesc: Acquires logs at the OS kernel level, capturing operations that other tools miss. Ideal for information leakage prevention and business improvement.
mylogstarFileServerDesc: Pinpoint monitoring of file server access — audit logs, user operations, and data input/output — without requiring a separate management server.
mylogstarDesktopDesc: Standalone log management and device control for individual PCs and small offices. Includes USB whitelist, screen snapshots, and trace functions.
mylogstarStandaloneDesc: Centrally collect, manage, and view logs from multiple MylogStar Desktop installations. Includes alert functions and comprehensive reporting.
potentialSavings: Potential monthly savings for 1,000 copies processed digitally, not including labor cost reductions.
etaxDesc: Japan System supports the full introduction of e-Tax Invoice, e-Receipt, and Digital Signatures — one of the nine key DX measures promoted by the Thai Revenue Department.
etaxBenefit1: Secure cloud or on-premise storage — eliminates risk of document loss.
etaxBenefit2: Certificates stored on the Revenue Department's server for official compliance.
etaxBenefit3: Sign documents anywhere — no need to physically visit the office.
etaxBenefit4: Full audit trail showing who signed when, preventing unauthorized use.
etaxNewsTitle: e-Tax Invoice & e-Receipt: Go Paperless with Digital Signatures
etaxNewsDesc: Transition from paper tax invoices to a secure, compliant, and fully digital workflow supported by the Thai Revenue Department.
mylogstarNewsTitle: MYLOGSTAR: Enterprise PC Log Management & Device Control
mylogstarNewsDesc: A powerful standalone log management system that tracks PC operations, file access, and USB activity — with no management server required.

timeline5: Expanded online marketing services including website development and social media management for Japanese businesses in Thailand.
